1.why: The UI uses a clean sans-serif typeface with clear letter and line spacing across all screenshots.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case with no italics, all-caps, or dense text blocks.

3.why: Layout is simple, centered, and appears well adapted to a narrow mobile viewport.

4.why: All instructional text is short and written in plain language.

5.why: No example or placeholder is shown for email, phone, or the expected six-digit code format.

6.why: No screen requires reading a long block of text to proceed.

7.why: No long codes or secrets are displayed with a copy affordance; the verification code must be typed manually.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry appears in any step.

9.why: Standard input fields are used so browser autofill may work, but support is not demonstrated or labeled.

10.why: Step headings and the blue primary action button stand out clearly on every screen.

11.why: Each screen asks for only one main action at a time.

12.why: Logs note that delivery was initiated, but after the error the system only says try again without stating what comes next.

13.why: The user can retry via the persistent button, yet no reveal/hide or re-request-code controls are shown.

14.why: The red error is generic ('We could not complete that request') and does not explain the problem or how to fix it.

15.why: No time limit or countdown is visible on any screen for reading or code entry.
